welcome: Grace and peace to you in the name of our Lord and Savior Jesus Christ.

Whether you are looking for a church home, returning after time away, or simply curious about the Lord, you are welcome here. Our doors are open, our hearts are open, and there is a seat with your name on it.
Come worship with us this Sunday. We would love to meet you.
